_comment: Shared test vectors. Used by BOTH the Python tests (ml/tests) and the Kotlin JVM tests (android). expected_normalised is null until F1 (the normaliser) defines the exact algorithm; it is then filled in from the agreed rules. All phone numbers are fake placeholders. Absent sender_in_contacts means unknown (null).
